Hi Amelie — welcome.

We can issue a provisional purchase reference for inbound logistics while the account is fully activated. Two requirements before we issue:
1) Corrected price list using the portal CSV (vendor_sku, description, unit_price, currency, lead_time_days). The validation errors you saw indicate the vendor_sku column was empty for ~8 lines.
2) Confirmation of the expected spend cap for the first 90 days (so we set the temporary envelope).

If you can upload the corrected CSV I will generate a provisional ref (format: PRV-2026-1193-<vendor>) and send the provisional_po_template.pdf for your acceptance. Once ledger assignment is complete we will convert the provisional ref to the formal PO number and reconcile itemization.

Attachments: provisional_po_template.pdf (template for provisional refs)

Cheers,
